summary: Register your app in Shopify's Dev Dashboard and choose a distribution model. Custom distribution (single store or Plus org) needs no review; public distribution (many stores) requires approval and a one-time Shopify App Store registration fee.
requirements: A redirect URI matching what you configure in the Dev Dashboard (or your app's shopify.app.toml)
The access scopes your integration needs
For public distribution: app listing assets (privacy policy, support contact, etc.) and the one-time App Store registration fee

steps.text: Create or sign in to a Shopify Partner account and open the Dev Dashboard.
Create an app and choose its distribution model: custom (one organization, no review) or public (many merchants, requires review + App Store registration).
Get your app's client ID and client secret from the Dev Dashboard.
Configure your redirect URI in the Dev Dashboard (or shopify.app.toml) and set the access scopes you need.
Implement the OAuth authorization code grant (or use Shopify CLI/app templates, which handle much of this for you).
For public distribution only: submit for app review and register on the Shopify App Store (one-time fee).

blockers: Public distribution requires passing Shopify's app review and a one-time Shopify App Store registration fee — custom distribution needs neither.
You can't change an app's distribution method after you select it.
Private apps were deprecated in January 2022 and can no longer be created — use custom distribution instead.
Redirect URI must exactly match what's configured in the Dev Dashboard / shopify.app.toml, or the OAuth flow fails.
Shopify CLI and app templates now handle most of the token exchange for you — you rarely implement raw OAuth by hand for a new app.

uncertainNotes: Exact review timeline for public distribution wasn't stated on the pages checked; 7 days is a rough industry-typical estimate, not a Shopify-confirmed figure — confirm current timelines before committing to a launch date.
App Store registration fee amount wasn't checked here.
verificationNotes: The automated pipeline's live run found no fetchable sources and fell back to general knowledge, which itself flagged (correctly, via self-check) that it was unsure whether the 'Partner Dashboard' / 'public vs custom' terminology it knew was still current.

Manually checked shopify.dev and found the terminology had indeed shifted: it's now the 'Dev Dashboard', and distribution is public vs. custom (not 'public vs private' app review as older material describes) — also found that public distribution requires a one-time App Store registration fee, which the auto-generated draft didn't mention at all, and that Shopify CLI/templates now handle most of the OAuth implementation.
